entities.name: RsmG/GidB
observations: Bacterial 239-residue rRNA guanine-N7 methyltransferase; exact sequence match to reviewed Staphylococcus epidermidis Q8CMN7.
Predicted molecular mass 27.14 kDa and theoretical pI 6.46.
Predicted cytosolic protein; no transmembrane or signal-peptide evidence reported.
Contains GidB domain PF02527 at residues 21–200 and Methyltransf_31 domain PF13847 at residues 71–161.

entities.name: 16S rRNA G535 methylation
observations: RsmG/GidB catalyzes N7 methylation of guanine 535 in 16S rRNA; UniProt EC classification is 2.1.1.- and no explicit equation was retrieved.

entities.name: 16S rRNA modification
observations: RsmG/GidB participates in bacterial small-subunit rRNA maturation by methylating 16S rRNA nucleotide G535.
